go.path.description: The go tool the Go tasks, gopls and the installs run: a name looked up on PATH, or a path. Empty: the one IED installed, else go on PATH or in Program Files\Go (Settings > Languages shows which).

go.languageServer.description: Run gopls for Go documents of trusted workspaces (Settings > Languages installs it).

go.gopls.path.description: The gopls to run: a name looked up on PATH, or a path. Empty: the one IED installed, else gopls in %USERPROFILE%\go\bin or on PATH.

go.delve.path.description: Delve (dlv), the Go debugger: a name looked up on PATH, or a path. Empty: the one IED installed, else dlv in %USERPROFILE%\go\bin or on PATH.
